generationInputs.prompt: A vintage-style poster, inspired by 1950s beauty ads, printed in a limited red-toned palette on a cream background. The poster features a stylized, engraved illustration of a luminous pink donut in the center, looking slightly off to the side with a neutral or sassy expression. The donut has a subtle holographic shimmer on its pink icing, with tiny, brightly colored, almost translucent sprinkles scattered across it. The donut's base is a soft golden hue, peeking through the translucent icing. At the top, a large, bold headline arches in all caps: "THIS IS MY EMOTIONAL SUPPORT DONUT." Below, a tagline reads: "No, You Cannot Have a Bite." Mid-century sparkle icons are scattered around the headline. Below the donut, a funny footer line states: "Mentally ooo." All fonts are retro vintage print ad style.
